title: Inventory Evidence Cutoff And Bounded Ledger Read Persistence
selectedSlice: C — acquire cutoff plus bounded enumeration persistence primitives
purpose: Expose a read-only global inventory-evidence high-water cutoff and deterministic exact-SKU ledger pagination bounded by an explicit cutoff.
rules: Cutoff acquisition reads the global maximum evidence_sequence from the FOOD-006H shared ledger.
An empty ledger produces explicit cutoff zero.
Cutoffs and cursors are nonnegative JavaScript safe integers.
Ledger evidence_sequence values are positive JavaScript safe integers.
Exact-SKU enumeration requires explicit SKU id/version and explicit cutoff.
Enumeration is ordered only by evidence_sequence ascending.
The cursor is evidence_sequence and means strictly greater than the prior returned sequence.
Every returned entry must have evidence_sequence greater than cursor and less than or equal to cutoff.
Pagination uses limit plus one and nextCursor is the last returned evidence_sequence only when more bounded rows exist.
Post-cutoff inserts are excluded naturally by evidence_sequence less-than-or-equal cutoff.
Batch ledger entries require no movement identity.
Movement ledger entries require a canonical nonempty movement identity.
Every returned row must match the requested exact SKU.
Malformed, duplicated, nonmonotonic, out-of-bound or uncertain durable rows fail closed as storage-failure.
Invalid caller selectors fail before storage access.
This slice is SELECT-only.
This slice does not construct a FOOD-006C manifest.
This slice does not prove that pagination has been fully exhausted across calls.
This slice therefore does not establish evidence completeness.
This slice does not establish authoritative current quantity-on-hand.
This slice does not establish capacity, availability, checkout, payment, fulfillment, accounting or rewards authority.
Migration 0005 remains definition-only and unexecuted.
deferred: Complete exhaustion orchestration through one acquired cutoff.
Binding cutoff provenance to a manifest.
